name: solution-rows
description: Centred heading over full-width capability rows: a tinted, colour-ruled card per row with an icon and title on the left and copy plus an optional link on the right; stacked below 1001px. Live: the .epx-sol section on the solution pages, Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification and Help Desk (rules ported).

title_accent.description: Words inside the heading painted with the brand gradient; must appear in title.

items.description: Rows. Each: title and body (line breaks kept); optional subtitle (a bold 20px line over the body, Ursa AI frame 7264:115165); optional tone (indigo, green, yellow, blue, red, cyan), icon_svg, badge (a small pill under the title, e.g. Winner: Asset Panda), link_label and url, and links (further text links, each {label, url}).

variant.description: solution: the six solution pages (wider gap, 360px title column, 24px link arrow). readiness: Emergency Preparedness and School Reunification. service: Help Desk.

tone_arrows.description: Paint each row's link arrow in the row's tone colour instead of indigo (Ursa AI frame 7261:113646).

head_width.description: Solution pages: the heading block's width cap in px (Asset Management 800, the others 640).
